item.title: Mosaic: Runtime-Efficient Multi-Agent Embodied Planning
item.description:
Mosaic is a new planning framework that solves the problem of high execution latency in multi-agent embodied planning by improving state tracking and coordination. The researchers built Mosaic, a runtime-efficient framework that maintains accurate state tracking and reduces redundant actions. The result is a more efficient planning system.

IT Breakdown: Not directly applicable to IT infrastructure work

item.title: LLM for EDA in Front-End Design: Challenges and Opportunities
item.description:
This research explores using Large Language Models for Electronic Design Automation, aiming to improve front-end design in chip development. It shows potential for automating tasks like HDL generation and testbench construction. This doesn't directly affect cloud infrastructure management.

IT Breakdown: Not directly applicable to IT infrastructure work, as it focuses on electronic design automation for chip development.

item.title: [News] SkillOpt: Agent skills as trainable parameters
item.description: Microsoft Research has developed SkillOpt, which turns agent skill editing into a training process. This makes agent behavior more reliable without changing model weights.

item.title: [News] Start building with Nano Banana 2 Lite and Gemini Omni Flash
item.description: Google DeepMind has announced a new product, Nano Banana 2 Lite and Gemini Omni Flash, but no specific details were provided about these products. This announcement from a major AI player still warrants attention, especially from those monitoring the vendor ecosystem.

item.title: [News] Expanding our Heat Resilience data to 50+ global cities
item.description: Google AI is expanding its Heat Resilience data to 50+ global cities. This adds new climate and sustainability insights to support decision-making.

item.title: [News] Introducing computer use in Gemini 3.5 Flash
item.description: Google DeepMind introduced computer use in Gemini 3.5 Flash, an update to the Google Workspace tool. This feature allows IT engineers to use AI to monitor and manage computer usage within the enterprise.

item.title: [News] Inside Microsoft’s two-decade push to cut water intensity while scaling for growth
item.description: Microsoft detailed its 20-year effort to reduce water usage in its datacenters. This aligns with growing community concerns over cloud infrastructure's local impact, yet has no direct relation to IT teams' day-to-day operations.
